subtitle: "A WFRC Quarto site in five minutes"

::: {.content-visible when-profile="docs"}
This repo is the `wfrc-brand` Quarto extension and the **starter template** for WFRC Analytics sites. You are reading the starter's own home page: a new site gets this same page, with the next steps below to work through. The [brand guide](brand-guide.qmd) and the [examples](example.qmd) are documentation only.
:::

## 1. Make a site from the template

You need [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/) 1.8 or later (tested on 1.11).

```bash
mkdir my-site && cd my-site
quarto use template WFRCAnalytics/wfrc-brand
quarto preview
```

The template installs the `wfrc-brand` extension and adds `_quarto.yml` and this page.

## 2. Make it yours

1. In `_quarto.yml`, set `website.title`, `description` and `site-url`.
2. Replace this page. Add pages next to it and list them under `website.navbar.left`.
3. Nothing to add for the navbar GitHub menu or the footer. The menu points at your repository by itself (it reads the git remote, or `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` in GitHub Actions), and the footer's Contact and Terms of use links go to single pages kept on wfrcanalytics.github.io.
4. If this site must differ from the org defaults (for example always re-run code with `execute: {freeze: false}`, or a different sidebar width), put only those differences in the `_site.yml` that came with the starter (it is already listed after the shared file). The [customizing guide](customize.qmd) has tested recipes.

## 3. What you get without writing any config

| | |
|---|---|
| **Look** | WFRC colors, Inter headings, Poppins body, light and dark mode that follows the visitor's setting. |
| **Navbar and footer** | The "Follow Us" menu, social links, copyright, Contact and Terms of use. |
| **Components** | Callouts, code blocks, tabsets, tables, cards, listings and dashboards, styled in both modes. |
| **Checks** | Accessibility checking with `axe`, and an accessibility script that fixes what Quarto leaves out. |
| **Other formats** | Slides (`format: wfrc-brand-revealjs`), PDF reports (`wfrc-brand-typst`) and dashboards (`wfrc-brand-dashboard`). |

## 4. Other formats

Put the format name in a page's front matter:

```yaml
---
title: "Transit ridership"
format: wfrc-brand-dashboard      # or wfrc-brand-revealjs, wfrc-brand-typst
---
```

## 5. Publish

Render with `quarto render`, then publish the output folder with GitHub Pages, or run `quarto publish gh-pages`.

## Choices you may want to change

- **Fonts.** The default loads Poppins, Inter and Fira Code from Google Fonts. For offline builds or no third-party requests, set `project.brand` to `_extensions/WFRCAnalytics/wfrc-brand/brand-offline.yml`, which uses fonts bundled with the extension (not for slides, because Quarto does not copy bundled fonts for revealjs).
- **Shiny, R and Python.** Use `_extensions/WFRCAnalytics/wfrc-brand/brand-flat.yml`: the same brand with light values only, because those packages do not read light/dark pairs.
